sections.label: Pitch Decks & Collaterals
sections.challenge: Your product is strong enough to raise a round, close a deal, or align the board — but the deck telling that story looks like it was made in a free template at midnight. Slides are cluttered, data visualizations are confusing, and the narrative doesn't build conviction the way the product itself does.

sections.heading: Why decks fail in the room

cards.title: The story arrives in the wrong order
cards.body: Investors need the problem, the insight, and the evidence before the product tour. We restructure the narrative first; design cannot rescue a sequence that argues backwards.

cards.title: The numbers are decorated, not explained
cards.body: Three-dimensional pie charts and unlabelled axes read as hiding something. We design each chart around the one comparison it exists to make.

cards.title: Every slide competes for attention
cards.body: If everything is bold, nothing is. One idea per slide, a visual hierarchy that survives a projector, and a version that still works when read on a phone.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Narrative review
steps.body: We read your current deck and your data room, then rebuild the storyline as a written outline. You approve the argument before anyone opens a design file.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: Design the argument
steps.body: Slide design, data visualization, and product imagery, delivered in batches so you can rehearse with real slides while the rest is still in progress.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Hand over a template
steps.body: Editable master slides in your tool of choice, with a component library for charts and layouts, so the next ten decks do not need us.

sections.heading: Trusted by our partners
sections.name: Aaron D.
sections.quote: Radiant exceeded all our expectations! Design and animations quality are on top level.

cards.body: A seed deck starts at [PLACEHOLDER: price]. A Series A deck with narrative work and custom data visualization is [PLACEHOLDER: range]. Priced per deck, with the template included.

cards.title: How fast can you turn one around?
cards.body: A focused redesign of an existing deck takes one to two weeks. Narrative plus design from scratch takes three. We have done faster for a live raise — ask.

cards.title: Do you write the content?
cards.body: We restructure the narrative and sharpen the wording. The claims, metrics, and financials come from you, and you sign off on every number that appears.

cards.title: Which tool do you deliver in?
cards.body: Figma, Google Slides, PowerPoint, or Keynote. We ask what you will present from and what your team can edit, then build natively in that — no exports that break on open.

cards.title: Do you sign NDAs?
cards.body: Yes, as standard, before we see anything. We work with companies in stealth and treat raise timing as confidential until you say otherwise.

cards.title: Can you design the data room too?
cards.body: Yes — one-pagers, case studies, financial summaries, and the proposal templates your sales team sends after the meeting.

sections.label: Next step
sections.challenge: Share what you have and who you are presenting to. We will come back with the three structural changes we would make, before you commit to anything.
